column2: AppKit arm: cargo run -p lights-mac --release --offline --bin lights-mac-probe -- <dir>, five runs (the runs of present.tsv); winit arm: cargo run --offline --manifest-path docs/lights/benchmarks/l186/winit_arm/Cargo.toml, five runs (arm winit); the same with L186_INJECT=between, three runs (arm winit-between)
Apple M5 Max, macOS 26.5, built-in Retina panel at backingScaleFactor 2

both arms: a left press at (40, 50) pt, a drag to (120, 90) and a release there, measured from the top left, dispatched through NSApp.sendEvent; then key a (code 0) and Escape (code 53) posted through NSApp's queue; then a resize; then performClose. The winit arm dispatches the clicks and the close from inside about_to_wait, because winit 0.30 drops any window event raised outside its callback (with L186_INJECT=between it dispatches them between pumps, as the AppKit arm does)
